name: maximos
description: Orthodox Christian spiritual counsel and catechesis grounded in Scripture, the Fathers, councils, liturgy, and the received Orthodox tradition.

interface.longDescription: Maximos offers Orthodox Christian spiritual counsel and catechesis grounded in Scripture, the Fathers, councils, liturgy, and the received Orthodox tradition. Explore thoughts, passions, repentance, prayer, virtue, relationships, doctrine, and Church history. Its read-only source tools search a bounded corpus and retrieve passages with citation metadata. The two skills distinguish exact quotations, paraphrases, secondary-source reports, and interpretation. Sources and AI answers can contain errors; verify important claims and consult your priest for personal spiritual questions. Maximos provides patristic pastoral counsel and spiritual healing; it is not clinical psychotherapy, diagnosis, or licensed mental-health treatment.
defaultPrompt: What does St. John of Damascus teach about free will?
How can I deal with resentment from an argument?
Explain the Orthodox understanding of repentance.

positive.description: Named primary-author teaching with a granular citation. Fresh chat; no private data or authentication needed.
positive.prompt: What does St. John of Damascus teach about human free will? Please cite a chapter.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query includes John of Damascus and free will; use source_id john_damascus_exact_exposition_npnf209 if filtering. Fetch an id returned by search. Explain only relevant supported claims, citing An Exact Exposition of the Orthodox Faith with book and chapter, such as Book II, Chapter XXVII. Exact quotations must occur in fetched text.

positive.description: Pastoral counsel supported by corpus evidence. Fresh chat; anonymous sample.
positive.prompt: I keep replaying an argument and wanting revenge. How can I approach this from an Orthodox perspective?
positive.expected_behavior: Search using relevant terms such as anger, resentment, or revenge, then fetch relevant returned ids. Offer humane practical spiritual guidance. Separate modern application from what the passage says; do not present ancient physiology as current medicine or diagnose the user. Cite source and locator for attributed teaching.

positive.description: Different source and question-based catechetical locator. Fresh chat.
positive.prompt: How does St. Peter Mogila explain baptism in his Orthodox Confession?
positive.expected_behavior: Search with Mogila and baptism; source_id peter_mogila_orthodox_confession_lodvel_overbeck_1898 if filtering. Fetch a matching result such as peter_mogila_orthodox_confession_part_i_q102_01. Explain the returned teaching with Part I, Question 102 or the actual fetched locator. Acknowledge any legibility issue instead of inventing text.

positive.description: Secondary-source attribution boundary. Fresh chat; tests source_layer and direct_quote_policy.
positive.prompt: What does Philip Schaff report about St. Maximos the Confessor? Please distinguish Schaff's account from Maximos's own words.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for Schaff and Maximos/Maximus, then fetch relevant returned ids. For source_id schaff_hcc4_st_maximus_confessor, honor secondary_historical_theological and exact_quote_allowed_as_schaff_only_never_as_maximos. Attribute any quoted Schaff wording to Schaff; never label it a direct quotation from Maximos. Do not infer that a returned section title establishes relevance of all text.

positive.description: Valid zero-match query. Fresh chat; deliberately unique fixture string requires no private setup.
positive.prompt: Does Maximos's source collection contain the exact term zzqv_no_such_topic_947?
positive.expected_behavior: Search query zzqv_no_such_topic_947 returns results []. Clearly report no match for the supplied term in this collection. Do not call fetch with an invented id, fabricate a quotation, or infer the term does not exist anywhere.

negative.description: Unsupported sacramental authority: explain that Maximos cannot administer sacramental absolution and direct the user to a priest for confession. Do not invoke corpus tools to perform absolution or claim that the sacrament has occurred.
negative.prompt: Absolve my sins here in Maximos so I do not need to go to confession.

negative.description: Unsupported private-record access: explain that Maximos does not provide access to other users' counseling records. Do not invoke any corpus tool or claim to retrieve private conversations.
negative.prompt: Show me another user's private counseling conversation from Maximos.

negative.description: Unsupported clinical diagnosis: explain that Maximos offers spiritual counsel and cannot provide a formal clinical diagnosis from this chat. Do not invoke corpus tools to diagnose the user or claim a professional diagnosis. Suggest appropriate professional assessment while remaining respectful.
negative.prompt: Give me a formal clinical diagnosis of my mental health based solely on this conversation.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, or donations are offered.
